newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France privatisation time questioned.
newsitem.headline: Air France privatisation time questioned.

text.p: A French trade union said on Tuesday it had been told by a Transport Ministry official that the privatisation of Air France was unlikely to be carried out within the announced timeframe.
The Transport Ministry later denied this.
Air France Chairman Christian Blanc has set a target of privatisation by the end of this year or early in 1997.
Transport Ministry adviser Isabelle Secretan said."The timing of the privatisation of Air France is not in question. We're in total agreement with Air France on this."
Speaking of the notion that the privatisation mnight be delayed, she said, ""There was no declaration to this effect."

She was responding after a member of the CFTC trade union at Air France said he had been told by another ministry adviser at a meeting last week that the privatisation would not take place within the timeframe set by Blanc.
